title: quick-sprint-outreach-tyler-nov05
content:
MORNING SPRINT NOTES - quick reference (Tyler)

Goal for today: 18 meaningful touches (calls + voicemails + emails) focused on mid-market accounts in EMEA timezone. Convert 3 discovery calls or get 3 agreed next steps.

Time blocks (hard windows):
- 08:30-10:00 GMT: warm account callbacks (people I spoke to last week)
- 11:00-12:30 GMT: cold introduction + sequence test (new ICs)
- 14:00-15:00 GMT: follow-ups and email cleanup
- 16:30-17:30 GMT: closing loop + schedule next week

PRIORITY LIST (top to bottom)
1) HORIZON ANALYTICS - VP Eng (contact: emailed 10/29, demo interest)
   - notes: wants predictable latency, asked about dedicated capacity pricing band, worried about data residency. Need short deck focused on Dedicated + private deployment options.
   - next step: call follow-up Wed 11/11 (ask to confirm infra constraints).
   - script hook: "we saw you run inference workloads with strict P95 targets — here’s how Redwood Dedicated helps stabilize costs and latency"

2) AURORA FINTECH - Head of ML Ops (intro via Rohan)
   - notes: compliance heavy, KMS required. Shared redacted SSO doc.
   - instant win: confirm KMS + audit logs via Private offering. Offer 30-min technical sync.

3) BAREFOOT HEALTH - Sr PM (trial expired)
   - notes: was on hosted plan, token spike caused throttling, wants autoscale details.
   - ask: whether they consider Dedicated or autoscale tweaks.

CALL TEMPLATES / MICRO-SCRIPTS (use for speed)
- Cold intro (30s): "Hi [First], Tyler from Redwood Inference. We help product teams ship LLM features with predictable latency and lower per-token costs. Quick question — are you owning inference infra or using hosted endpoints?"
- Warm callback (45s): "Hey [First], following up on our last note about latency SLOs — I can share a short case that shows 3x reduction in unit cost with caching and batching. Free 20-min next week?"
- Voicemail (20s): "Hi [First], Tyler at Redwood Inference — quick note about reducing inference costs without sacrificing latency. Shoot me two times that work, or reply with a good person to loop in. Thanks."

EMAIL SNIPPET (follow-up after call)
- Subject: "Re: latency & cost — quick follow-up"
- Body first paragraph: "Thanks for your time today. As promised, attaching the Dedicated vs Hosted one-pager and our typical deployment checklist. TL;DR: Dedicated gives predictable throughput and isolation; Private adds KMS/HSM + VPC. Happy to set up a 30-min technical sync."

CONCURRENCY / NOTES FOR THE DAY
- testing new cadence: call -> voicemail -> email within 24h for warm leads.
- measure: log every touch in Salesforce with outcome + next action. Goal: update stage within 12h.
- metric reminders: conversion target 3/18, response rate benchmark 15% for this cohort.

OBJECTIONS + FAST RESPONSES
- "We host our own models" -> "Totally. Redwood can run in your VPC or on-prem and integrate with your KMS, so you keep control + get runtime optimizations."
- "We care about cost" -> "We run workload-aware batching + KV prefix caching and provide Optimize recommendations that often cut per-token bill by 30-50% depending on traffic shape."

ADMIN TODOS (tick off)
- [ ] Upload Dedicated one-pager to Aurora Fintech thread (done?)
- [ ] Share KMS integration doc with Horizon Analytics
- [ ] Create quick demo env for Barefoot Health (request dev token)
- [ ] Log all outcomes in SF by EOD

RAPID NOTES FROM CALLS (shorthand)
- 09:05 - Horizon: wants pricing band 50-200 p95 target, legal ok with SOC2 but need GDPR specifics. Put legal PD on cc for next mail.
- 09:27 - Aurora: KMS ok, wants network diagram. Rohan will intro infra lead.
- 11:12 - Cold call: got voicemail, left script, will email follow up.

FOLLOW-UPS (specific)
- Horizon: send tailored pricing + compliance snippet by 11/06 17:00 GMT.
- Barefoot: propose 30-min autoscale deep-dive, drop 2 slots Tue/Wed next week.
- Aurora: request network diagram + confirm audit retention policy.

LEARNINGS / A/B TESTS
- Testing new voicemail script (shorter) — log response if we get >10% reply.
- Testing sending one-pager in first email vs after call — track replies.

END-OF-DAY WRAP (what to capture)
- Quick bullet to update SF: wins, active next steps, warmest lead.
- Leave 1-hour buffer tomorrow morning for follow-ups from EMEA after my calls.

MISC QUICK CLIPPINGS
- remember: mention "rollouts" and "canary fallback" when talking reliability.
- add link to case study: confluence://case-studies/horizon-latency-win in follow-up mail.

NOTES TO SELF:
- breathe. prioritize demos > price discussions in first meeting.
- keep pitches focused on concrete metrics (latency p95, cost per token, SLO percentiles).

------
Revision history: rough scratchpad, will tidy if any discovery calls schedule.
